scripts.text:
[La Ed]
There MUST be a treasure hidden in that place!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
那个地方肯定藏着宝藏！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
If we find it, people will no longer think we're losers~!!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
如果我们找到了，大家就不会再觉得我们是失败者了~！！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Finally!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
终于！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Let's go find that treasure!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
我们去找那个宝藏吧！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Let's do it~ !!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
行动吧~！！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
By the way...do you think he
would tell us about such a
great treasure so easily?
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
话说回来……你觉得他会这么轻易地告诉我们关于这么大一笔宝藏的事吗？

scripts.text: Hm? What treasure?
scripts.translation: 嗯？什么宝藏？

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Wha--?! when did you start listening to us?!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
什——？！你什么时候开始偷听我们说话的？！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Huh...seems like you wanna know
more about the treasure. Well,
this information doesn't come cheap...
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
哈……看来你很想知道关于宝藏的事。不过，这情报可不便宜……

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Plus, we'll need a little
a little something in case
*cough!* ^555555we don't find
anything at all.^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
而且，万一^555555我们什么都没找到^000000，我们也得留点*咳咳！*小钱防身。

scripts.text:
[La Ed, Haith]
If you pay us 1,000 zeny, we will tell you!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德，海斯]
如果你付给我们1,000泽尼，我们就告诉你！

scripts.text: Pay 1,000 zeny
scripts.translation: 支付1,000泽尼

scripts.text: Refuse to pay
scripts.translation: 拒绝支付

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Hahahaha! You the man!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
哈哈哈！你真够意思！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Okay, not too long ago, a famous
adventurer named Niels came back from his travels.
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
好吧，不久前，一位名叫尼尔斯的著名冒险者旅行归来。

scripts.text:
[Haith]
*Whispers*
^555555He brought a big box with him.^000000
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
*低语*
^555555他带回来一个大箱子。^000000

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Also, he came back in the middle
of the night without telling
anyone. So, of course he's got
some secret, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
而且，他是半夜回来的，没告诉任何人。所以，他肯定有什么秘密，你不觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[Haith]
What could be inside that box~?
It just has to be treasure!!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
那箱子里会是什么呢~？肯定是宝藏！！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
So! We decided to go on a journey to find treasure of our own-!!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
所以！我们决定踏上寻找属于我们自己宝藏的旅程-！！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
The problem is, we are not sure
whether or not Niels would tell
us the location of where he
found the treasure...
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
问题是，我们不确定尼尔斯会不会告诉我们他发现宝藏的地点……

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Because Niels always treat us like
we're stupid!! Bah~!!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
因为尼尔斯总是把我们当傻瓜对待！！哼~！！

scripts.text: Where is this Niels person?
scripts.translation: 这个叫尼尔斯的人在哪？

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
He's staying at the northern part
of this village.
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
他住在这个村庄的北部。

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Since we gave you good information,
we expect that you pay us back!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
既然我们给了你这么好的情报，希望你也能回报我们！

scripts.text:
[La Ed, Haith]
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德，海斯]
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Oh well~! If you don't have the money, then we can't give you the information~
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
哎呀~！如果你没钱，那我们就不能给你情报了~

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Bah! Whatever~
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
哼！随便啦~

scripts.text:
[Iriya]
Mr. Niels is at the table in the
corner. He has many interesting
stories about the world.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉娅]
尼尔斯先生坐在角落的桌子旁。他有很多关于这个世界的有趣故事。

scripts.text:
[Iriya]
I am not sure where he has been
this time. He just laughs and
says 'I don't think I am fit
for this teaching job.'
scripts.translation:
[伊莉娅]
我不确定他这次去了哪里。他只是笑着说“我觉得我不适合做老师这份工作”。

scripts.text:
[Iriya]
In the meantime, people keep
visiting Mr. Niels... and I
can't help but wonder...
Where has he gone?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉娅]
与此同时，人们不断拜访尼尔斯先生……我不禁在想……他到底去了哪里？

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Hmm? What's that look for?
Ah~ You must of heard the rumors
of me finding some kind of
treasure. Yeah, that's understandable...
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
嗯？这是什么表情？
啊~你一定听到了关于我找到某种宝藏的传言。是啊，这也难怪……

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Well, those rumors of me stumbling
on some wonderful treasure is
just the result of overactive
imaginations. All I've found
was a little something to add
to my collection.
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
好吧，那些关于我偶然发现奇妙宝藏的传言，只是想象力过于活跃的结果。我所发现的只是一些能丰富我收藏的小东西。

scripts.text:
[Niels]
But...since I've proven to myself
that 'it' actually exists by
seeing it with my own eyes,
to me, what I've obtained is a
valuable treasure.
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
但是……既然我亲眼看到了“它”的存在，证明它是真实存在的，那么对我而言，我所获得的就是珍贵的宝藏。

scripts.text:
[Niels]
This village of Comodo!
Don't you think the caves are too
small and narrow for some reason?
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
克魔岛这个村庄！
你不觉得这里的洞穴不知为何太小太窄了吗？

scripts.text:
[Niels]
So I was thinking about it...
And I came to the conclusion that
there should be something hidden
inside the cave...
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
所以我一直在想……
我得出的结论是，洞穴里应该隐藏着什么东西……

scripts.text:
[Niels]
And then!
I finally found it.
The patch to 'the place'
that no one has ever found!
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
然后！
我终于找到了。
通往那个无人知晓之“地”的入口！

scripts.text:
[Niels]
.......Hm?

[Niels]
I was expecting a spectacular and
rather dramatic sound effect
for my declaration!
Eh, oh well...
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
我原本期待我的宣言能伴随着壮观而戏剧性的音效！
唉，算了……

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Well, in the spirit of discovery,
don't ever think of asking me
about directions to 'the place'
or about what is in 'the place.'
I wouldn't want to spoil the
surprise.
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
好吧，本着探索的精神，别想着问我关于去那个“地方”的路线或者那个“地方”里有什么。
我可不想破坏惊喜。

scripts.text:
[Niels]
If you're a real adventurer,
I expect you to scream at the
top of your lungs...
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
如果你是个真正的冒险者，
我希望你大声尖叫……

scripts.text:
[Niels]
'Ahhhh! I need to know what it
is!!' Kick the door open and run
like hell to find this place on
your own!!
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
“啊啊啊！我必须知道那是什么！！”踢开大门，拼命跑去亲自寻找这个地方！！

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Now! Hurry and seek this place
out! Will this place be a totally
new world, or will it be a trap
to hell?! Go forth, meet your
destiny, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
现在！快去寻找这个地方！这究竟是一个全新的世界，还是地狱的陷阱？！前进吧，去迎接你的命运，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[???]
Huh?
You're not one of us, are you?
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
哈？
你不是我们的一员，对吧？

scripts.text:
[???]
Heh! Hi!
My name is Haatan.
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
嘿！你好！
我叫哈坦。

scripts.text:
[Haatan]
...*Sigh*
I am sorry, but I cannot play with
you right now. My parent's house
was struck by lightning yesterday
and it burned down our roof...
scripts.translation:
[哈坦]
...*叹气*
抱歉，我现在不能陪你玩。昨天闪电击中了我父母的房子，把屋顶烧毁了……

scripts.text:
[Haatan]
 . . . !

[Haatan]
Oh yes! Could you help me?
You look pretty well off...
Can donate some money for
re-constructing my parents' house?
You Rune-Midgartsians are all
richer than Utans! I beg you!
scripts.translation:
[哈坦]
哦对了！你能帮帮我吗？
你看起来挺富裕的……
能捐点钱帮我重建父母的房子吗？
你们卢恩·米德加兹人都比乌坦人有钱！求求你了！

scripts.text: (Nod head)
scripts.translation: (点头)

scripts.text: (Shake head)
scripts.translation: (摇头)

scripts.text:
[Haatan]
Whoaaaa!!
You the man~!
Thank you so much, yay~!
scripts.translation:
[哈坦]
哇啊啊！！
你真够意思~！
太感谢你了，耶~！

scripts.text:
[Haatan]
Uh...
It looks like...
You don't have much
yourself...
scripts.translation:
[哈坦]
呃……
看起来……
你自己也没什么钱……

scripts.text:
[Haatan]
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[哈坦]
太感谢你了！

乌巴乌巴 乌巴巴乌巴乌姆胡姆巴！乌巴！

乌~巴乌姆巴~ 乌~巴乌姆巴~
乌~巴乌姆巴~ 乌~巴乌姆巴~

Umba umba umbaum.

scripts.translation:
[科坦]
哇，你真的要给我肉吗？谢谢！我会用这些作为回报。

scripts.text:
[Kotan]
Hah! You don't have Meat,
but pretend that you do?!
I hate people who lie
to me!!
scripts.translation:
[科坦]
哈！你没有肉，却装作有？！
我讨厌对我撒谎的人！！

[Pasto]
Oh my god~! Finally,
another Rune-Midgartsian!
I've never seen anyone from
home in this place before!
Nice to meet you, my name is Pasto!
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
天哪~！终于，
又见到一个卢恩·米德加兹人了！
我以前在这里从未见过来自家乡的人！
很高兴认识你，我叫帕斯托！

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
This place is called Umbala.
The local people in this village
have formed a culture that's
totally different from other
places I've been.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
这个地方叫汶巴拉。
这个村庄的当地人形成了一种与我我去过的其他地方完全不同的文化。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
I guess it's because this
place has been isolated from
other regions because of its
geographical features.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
我想这是因为这个地方由于地理特征而与其他地区隔离开来。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
They look different from us, and
use a language that is still very
confusing to me. I was also
confounded by their different use
of facial expression.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
他们看起来和我们不同，使用的语言也让我非常困惑。他们不同的面部表情用法也令我感到困惑。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
Of course, there are some
similarities. However, you might
want to be careful about certain
issues.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
当然，也有一些相似之处。然而，在某些问题上你可能需要小心。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
Sometimes, what you say or do
or do could be misinterpreted as
having the totally opposite meaning.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
有时候，你的言行可能会被误解为完全相反的意思。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
I wish I could speak their
language...*Sigh*
...Or I wish I could meet more
people here that speak my
language...I...I'm...
So very lonely...*Sob*
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
我真希望我能说他们的语言...*叹气*
...或者我希望在这里能遇到更多说我的语言的人...我...我...
好孤独...*抽泣*

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
Umbah umbah woogawoo...
oops, sorry! I'm so used
to speaking in Utan by now.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
乌巴 乌巴 乌嘎乌...
哎呀，抱歉！我现在太习惯说乌坦语了。
很高兴认识你。

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
I never imagined that I would
meet another person from
the homeland in this village.
Hahahahah~!
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
我从未想过会在这个村庄遇到另一个来自家乡的人。
哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
I came here to seek strong people
to help me master my fighting
skills. But I was soon frustrated
because it took me a long
time to learn the language...
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
我来这里是为了寻找强者，以帮助我精通战斗技巧。但我很快就感到沮丧，因为学习语言花了我很长时间……

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
Well, now I am kind of used to my
circumstances. Even though it
took me a while to used to
Utan culture. Hahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
好吧，现在我已经有点适应这种处境了。虽然我花了一段时间才适应乌坦文化。哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
But you know what was the weirdest
thing I found out about Utan
culture? At first the Utan men
seemed to have, shall we say, a
strong species preservation instinct.
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
但你知道我发现乌坦文化中最奇怪的是什么吗？起初，乌坦男性似乎有着，怎么说呢，强烈的物种保护本能。

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
There are many Utan playboys in
this village. Some may think
the Utans are primitive in
this respect, but...
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
这个村庄里有很多乌坦花花公子。有些人可能认为乌坦人在这一点上很原始，但是……

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
As I learned more about them,
I eventually realized that their
courtship rituals are actually
more advanced than anything the
Rune-Midgarts culture has to offer.
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
随着我对他们了解的加深，我最终意识到他们的求爱仪式实际上比卢恩·米德加兹文化提供的任何方式都要先进。

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
It's really quite fascinating.
I'm actually still learning
quite much from the Utan
playboys and their awesome methods.
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
这真的非常迷人。
我实际上还在从乌坦花花公子和他们了不起的方法中学到很多东西。

scripts.text:
[Jertan]
Bungee jumping can be dangerous,
and you can risk your life doing
it. We Utans have consider
bungee jumping an important
part of the ceremony of
becoming an adult.
scripts.translation:
[杰尔坦]
蹦极很危险，可能会危及生命。我们乌坦人将蹦极视为成年仪式的重要组成部分。

scripts.text:
[???]
Umbaumbah humba.
Woo umbaumbaumbabah woo humbah
Umbababah umba umba.
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
乌巴乌巴 胡姆巴。
乌 乌巴乌巴乌巴巴 乌 胡姆巴
乌巴巴巴 乌巴 乌巴。

scripts.text:
[Arotan]
Completing the bungee jump
is very difficult to do.
Today, we are here in celebration
of the people that made it and
have shown their courage.
scripts.translation:
[阿罗坦]
完成蹦极是非常困难的。
今天，我们在这里庆祝那些成功完成并展现出勇气的人们。

scripts.text:
[???]
Woo umbaumbaumbabah woo humbah
Umbababah umba umba.
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
乌 乌巴乌巴乌巴巴 乌 胡姆巴
乌巴巴巴 乌巴 乌巴。

scripts.text:
[Klumatan]
It's really scary, falling from
such a high place...
But I guess you have to do it,
otherwise no one will ever
consider you a grownup.
scripts.translation:
[克卢马坦]
从这么高的地方掉下来真的很可怕……
但我想你必须这么做，否则没人会把你当作成年人。

scripts.text:
[Klumatan]
I guess I don't want to
be a grownup right away.
But some kids my age are
in too big of a hurry
to not be kids anymore.
scripts.translation:
[克卢马坦]
我想我现在还不想马上长大。
但我同龄的一些孩子太急于不再当孩子了。

scripts.text:
[???]
Umbahumba umumbah.
Umbahumbah umbabah.
Umbahumhumbabahum.
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
乌巴胡姆巴 乌姆巴。
乌巴胡姆巴 乌巴巴。
乌巴胡姆胡巴巴胡姆。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
What up, loser!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
哟，失败者！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
What's the matter,
ya big Rune-Midgartsian?!?!
I just called you a 'loser!'
I guess you're too stupid
to understand!!
Hahahahahahaahahhahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
怎么了，
你这个大块头卢恩·米德加兹人？！?!
我刚叫你“失败者”！
我想你太笨了听不懂！！
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
...
Uh...oh!

[Bertan]
It looks like you can understand
me--! Good job, good job!
Alright, by way of apology,
do you want to hear a joke?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
看来你能听懂我的话--！干得好，干得好！
好吧，作为道歉，你想听个笑话吗？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Alright, alright.
Here we go.
Ummmm...
Alright, I got one.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
好吧，好吧。
开始了。
嗯……
好了，我有一个。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
What did the Rune-Midgartsian
say to the Savage?
...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
卢恩·米德加兹人对野猪说了什么？
...

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
I don't know...
But they didn't have any
trouble understanding
each other!!! HAHAHAHA~!
Get it? 'Cuz, like,
they're both pigs~!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
我不知道……
但他们互相理解起来没有任何困难！！！哈哈哈哈~！
懂了吗？因为，你看，
他们都是猪~！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Not funny, huh?
Oh well. I guess my
sense of humor is just
too sophisticated.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
不好笑，是吧？
算了。我想我的
幽默感只是
太高级了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Okay...what's the best
way to tame an Orc Lady?
Give up..?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
好吧……驯服兽人女子的最好方法是什么？
放弃了吗..?

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
With a wedding ring!
HAHAHAHAHAHAHHA!
Oh God~ I'm hilarious!!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
用结婚戒指！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！
天哪~我太搞笑了！！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
...
...Wait.
Wait a minute...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
...
...等等。
等一下……

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
That's not even funny...
Just incredibly...
Scary...
Brrr--!
She's hideous!!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
那甚至不好笑……
只是极其……
可怕……
嘶--！
她太丑了！！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Actually...forget it.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
其实……算了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
I was going to say a
knock knock joke about
Isis, but then decided
that kind of humor is
too low brow.
...Zing!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
我本来想说一个关于蛇女伊丝的敲门笑话，但后来决定那种幽默太俗气了。
...叮！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Why are Rune-Midgartsians
SOOoOOoo...
Um, hmmmmm.
Maybe that joke
isn't so good for this
situation, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
为什么卢恩·米德加兹人
SOOoOOoo...
嗯，嗯mmm。
也许那个笑话
在这种情况下不太合适，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Okay, why is it that
GMs prefer not to be
seen...? Give up?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
好吧，为什么GM们不喜欢被看到……？放弃了吗？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
BECAUSE THOSE GUYS WEAR
SKIRTS ~! HAHAHA!
OH MAN, I MADE A FUNNY!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
因为那些家伙穿裙子 ~！哈哈哈！
天哪，我讲了个笑话！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
*Whew* Yowza~
Oh, man.
Utterly classic.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
*呼* 哇哦~
哦，天哪。
绝对经典。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
A Crusader, an Alchemist and a Novice walk into a bar.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
一个十字军、一个炼金术士和一个初心者走进酒吧。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Inside, they see a sign that
says '^CC0000Monster Help Agency:
LADIES ONLY.^000000'
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
在里面，他们看到一个牌子写着“^CC0000魔物帮助机构：
女士专用。^000000”

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
'^000099Oh!^000000' says the Crusader.
'^000099It's a lucky thing we are
all ladies.^000000' She goes up
and says '^000099Gimmie a ride.^000000'
Kinda rude for a Crusader,
but whatever.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
“^000099哦！^000000”十字军说。“^000099幸好我们都是女士。^000000”她走上前说“^000099载我一程。^000000”对十字军来说有点粗鲁，但无所谓。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Out of nowhere, this
Grand PecoPeco appears
and is all '^CC0000I'll give you
a ride, baby. Careful, this
road can get buuuuumpy.^000000'
And then they're off.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
突然，一只巨大的大嘴鸟出现，说道“^CC0000宝贝，我载你一程。小心，这条路可能会有点颠簸。^000000”然后他们就出发了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Next comes the Alchemist
and she's like '^330099I need
help killing Zombies^000000' and
then this Marine Sphere
comes from out of
nowhere and is all...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
接下来是炼金术士，她说“^330099我需要帮忙杀腐尸^000000”，然后一个气泡虫不知从哪里冒出来，说道……

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
'^CC0000I got your fire. Careful
baby, touch me the wrong
way and I might just
exploooode.^000000' So then
they're off on their
merry way too.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
“^CC0000我有你的火。小心点宝贝，惹错了我可能会爆炸。^000000”于是他们也愉快地出发了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Finally, the Novice
comes up and says
'^006633I need someone to
party with.^000000'
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
最后，初心者走上前说“^006633我需要有人组队。^000000”

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Out of nowhere, this
Hode pops up and says...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
突然，一只蚯蚓跳出来，说道……

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
'^CC0000I know some people
but let me check my
Rolodex. HODE on!^000000'
....
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
“^CC0000我认识一些人，但让我查查我的通讯录。HODE on！^000000”....

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Well, come on!
I can't be funny
all the time, you know?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
喂，拜托！
我不可能一直都很搞笑，你知道吧？

scripts.text:
[Boorkatan]
Huh? You're from Rune-Midgarts,
aren't you? Have you ever been bungee jumping?
scripts.translation:
[布尔卡坦]
哈？你是来自卢恩·米德加兹的，对吧？你玩过蹦极吗？

scripts.text: Yeah
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Boorkatan]
Whoa, what a surprise! I never
would have thought someone from
outside would know how to do it.
Okay, I'll take your word for
it and welcome you to our village.
scripts.translation:
[布尔卡坦]
哇，真令人惊讶！我从未想过外面的人会知道怎么做。
好吧，我相信你说的话，欢迎你来到我们的村庄。

scripts.text:
[Boorkatan]
Er, I see...
As part of the ceremony of
adulthood, all Utans have to do
a bungee jump. When I grow up,
I'm gonna do it too, and prove
to everybody that I am a man!
scripts.translation:
[布尔卡坦]
呃，我明白了……
作为成年仪式的一部分，所有乌坦人都必须进行蹦极。等我长大了，我也要去做，向所有人证明我是个男子汉！

scripts.text:
[Weitan]
I too did the bungee jump when I
was young. I remember it well...
It was my first time, and the
ground rushed up to meet me...
For a moment, I thought I was
going to get myself killed...
scripts.translation:
[韦坦]
我年轻时也做过蹦极。我记得很清楚……
那是我第一次，地面迅速向我冲来……
有一瞬间，我以为自己要没命了……

scripts.text:
[Weitan]
But after I made it, I was so
proud of myself~
Some Utans may not agree, but
I think bungee jumping is an
important part of the ceremony
of adulthood.
scripts.translation:
[韦坦]
但成功后，我为自己感到非常自豪~
有些乌坦人可能不同意，但我认为蹦极是成年仪式的重要组成部分。

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
It's been a long time since I last
saw a Rune-Midgartsian~!
Welcome, stranger.
scripts.translation:
[祖尔坦]
好久没见到卢恩·米德加兹人了~！
欢迎，陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
We Utans use this place for
bungee jumping. Many Utan
youngsters have shown their
bravery, earned their
self-respect, and became
adults in this very place.
scripts.translation:
[祖尔坦]
我们乌坦人用这个地方进行蹦极。许多乌坦年轻人在这里展现了勇气，赢得了自尊，成为了成年人。

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
Oh...right. A few unlucky people
just fell and died after
messing up their bungee jump. And
a few had heart attacks while
looking at other people jumping down...
scripts.translation:
[祖尔坦]
哦……对了。有几个倒霉的人在蹦极失误后坠落身亡。还有几个人在看别人跳下去时心脏病发作……

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
So...
Be careful when you walk around,
You don't want to fall off.
And if you want to try a bungee
jump, you should get yourself ready.
scripts.translation:
[祖尔坦]
所以……
走路时要小心，
你不想掉下去。
如果你想尝试蹦极，你应该做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
Oh...right. Supposedly,
there's an unidentified
creature living in the water...
So if you happen to get dunked,
get out of there~!
scripts.translation:
[祖尔坦]
哦……对了。据说，
水里住着一种不明生物……
所以如果你不小心掉进去，赶紧出来~！

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
Umbala has many many trees!
I, Mutakutan, like trees so much.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
汶巴拉有很多很多树！
我，穆塔库坦，非常喜欢树。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
There is one special tree I like
the most! That is the oldest and
biggest tree in Umbala!
No wait, I think it is the oldest
and biggest in the world...
I'm sure it is!
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
有一棵特别的树我最喜欢！那是汶巴拉最古老最大的树！
不，等等，我想它是世界上最古老最大的……
我敢肯定！

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
It's really really big and old!
It's so tall, even I haven't seen
the top of this tree yet. I tried
climbing it before, but I could
never reach the top...even though
I'm great at tree climbing.
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
它真的非常大且古老！
它太高了，连我都还没见过这棵树的顶端。我以前试着爬过，但永远到不了顶端……尽管我很擅长爬树。

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
Oh, also the fruits from the tree
are very tasty! I bet they are the
most delicious fruit in the world~
Sweet and sour...eating it just
makes you feel refreshed and
invigorated~!
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
哦，还有树上的水果非常美味！我敢打赌它们是世界上最好吃的水果~
酸甜可口……吃了它让你感到清爽和充满活力~！

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
There's an amazing story about
this fruit. An old man in my
village was suffering from a
mortal disease...nothing
seemed to help...
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
关于这种水果有一个惊人的故事。我村里的一个老人患有一种绝症……似乎什么都没用……

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
But after he took medicine made
from the ground leaves of this
tree, he became healthy and sound
again! I think God sent us the
tree to bless us.
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
但在他服用了用这棵树的叶子磨成的药后，他又恢复了健康！我想是上帝派这棵树来祝福我们的。

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
It's at north of my village, so
why don't you go see the greatness
of this tree for yourself?
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
它在我村庄的北边，所以你为什么不亲自去看看这棵树的伟大之处呢？
